對照「JUWELS Booster：建立可追溯輸入與所有權」的名義結果，分別建立系統故障與量測／紀錄偏移兩個解釋。指定一項能分辨它們的獨立觀察，再依證據選擇處置。教學驗收要求總量守恆且 skew 不超過 1.25；變更通過，但仍需重新測試共享資料讀取與遷移的實際成本。
本階段必須重驗：逐群加總必須回到 80；把八群排序不改變 skew；另測全零輸入並明確拒絕除以零；保存來源、合成輸入及 join/所有權失敗的明確原因；不得悄悄補缺值。
steps.instructionEn:
A hotspot may arise from true placement concentration or accounting that charges the same shared pages to every rank. These explanations require different repairs even when the displayed maximum is identical. Inspect array identities and fragment intervals for duplicates. Distinguish virtual mappings from attributed physical storage; compare like-for-like definitions before interpreting domain imbalance.
Against the nominal JUWELS Booster: construct traceable inputs and ownership result, build competing system-fault and sensing/logging-offset explanations. Name an independent observation that separates them and select the disposition from evidence. Require conservation and a teaching skew limit of 1.25. The balanced fixture passes, while an operational recommendation still needs measurements of shared-data access, migration cost and memory-controller pressure.
Reverify this criterion: Reconcile domain totals to 80 GiB, verify invariance under domain reordering and reject an all-zero vector as an undefined ratio. Confirm the nominal average independently from the individual ledger rows. Preserve provenance, synthetic inputs and explicit join or ownership failures; do not silently fill missing values.
steps.observation: 證據能區分兩個成因；不足時明列待測量，不把猜測當結案。熱點可能源於資料放置，也可能是統計將共享頁面重複歸給所有 rank；利用陣列識別碼與分片區間檢查重複；比對程序虛擬大小與實體歸屬的定義，不能混用兩者。
steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. A hotspot may arise from true placement concentration or accounting that charges the same shared pages to every rank. These explanations require different repairs even when the displayed maximum is identical. Inspect array identities and fragment intervals for duplicates. Distinguish virtual mappings from attributed physical storage; compare like-for-like definitions before interpreting domain imbalance.
steps.failure: 相同警報直接等同同一故障，沒有獨立觀察。
steps.failureEn: Equating the same alert with the same cause without an independent observation.

Confirm the nominal average independently from the individual ledger rows. Preserve provenance, synthetic inputs and explicit join or ownership failures; do not silently fill missing values.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: 以 JUWELS Booster 的分區拓撲為例，評估記憶體容量足夠卻集中到單一 NUMA 群的配置；本課不重複 first-touch 入門。
knowledge.textEn: Use JUWELS Booster to investigate a placement that fits aggregate memory but concentrates working sets in one NUMA domain. The emphasis is a partition audit beyond introductory first-touch behavior.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 建立 array_id、bytes、home_domain 表，將一個陣列跨群的情形分成可核對的分片；不得重複計數共享陣列。
knowledge.textEn: Build an array_id, bytes and home_domain ledger. Represent a split array with explicit disjoint fragments, and deduplicate shared logical arrays before aggregating domain loads.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 工作集偏斜定義為最大群負載除以八群平均負載；它是配置不均指標，不是總體效能降低比例。
knowledge.textEn: Define skew as maximum domain load divided by the mean over eight domains. This placement metric reveals imbalance but does not directly predict application slowdown or bandwidth loss.

steps.title: JUWELS Booster：建立可追溯輸入與所有權 · 驗收並留下交接件
steps.titleEn: JUWELS Booster: construct traceable inputs and ownership · Accept and hand over evidence
steps.objective: 完成「JUWELS Booster：建立可追溯輸入與所有權」的驗收並留下交接件，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete accept and hand over evidence for JUWELS Booster: construct traceable inputs and ownership and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
交付工作集帳本、分片移動清單、兩組群負載圖與重複歸屬反例；附可執行實作：python3 tools/curriculum-v27/labs-hpc-a.py --lab hpc-v27-006 --out ./hpc-a-006-evidence；輸出資料夾須不存在，程式提供逐筆合成證據。
在交接件中加入「JUWELS Booster：建立可追溯輸入與所有權」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：逐群加總必須回到 80；把八群排序不改變 skew；另測全零輸入並明確拒絕除以零；保存來源、合成輸入及 join/所有權失敗的明確原因；不得悄悄補缺值。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：建立 array_id、bytes、home_domain 表，將一個陣列跨群的情形分成可核對的分片；不得重複計數共享陣列。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver the working-set ledger, fragment-migration list, both domain-load distributions and a duplicate-accounting counterexample. Include a concise explanation of why total free memory alone did not reveal the problem. Executable fixture: python3 tools/curriculum-v27/labs-hpc-a.py --lab hpc-v27-006 --out ./hpc-a-006-evidence. The output directory must not exist; the program emits per-record synthetic evidence.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for JUWELS Booster: construct traceable inputs and ownership: Reconcile domain totals to 80 GiB, verify invariance under domain reordering and reject an all-zero vector as an undefined ratio. Confirm the nominal average independently from the individual ledger rows. Preserve provenance, synthetic inputs and explicit join or ownership failures; do not silently fill missing values.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Build an array_id, bytes and home_domain ledger. Represent a split array with explicit disjoint fragments, and deduplicate shared logical arrays before aggregating domain loads. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。逐群加總必須回到 80；把八群排序不改變 skew；另測全零輸入並明確拒絕除以零；保存來源、合成輸入及 join/所有權失敗的明確原因；不得悄悄補缺值。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. Reconcile domain totals to 80 GiB, verify invariance under domain reordering and reject an all-zero vector as an undefined ratio. Confirm the nominal average independently from the individual ledger rows. Preserve provenance, synthetic inputs and explicit join or ownership failures; do not silently fill missing values.

steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.

steps.checkEn: Reconcile domain totals to 80 GiB, verify invariance under domain reordering and reject an all-zero vector as an undefined ratio. Confirm the nominal average independently from the individual ledger rows. Preserve provenance, synthetic inputs and explicit join or ownership failures; do not silently fill missing values.
